Name: SpM's Configurable Farm Maps
Author: SpaceMinion
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/x5uOxcG.png[/img]﻿
[size=5] ﻿It allows you to [/size][size=5]patch [i]small  [/i]sections of your [b]Farm[/b][/size][size=5],
﻿and all of it can be Configured quickly and [/size][size=5]enjoyed without re-loading your save/game.[/size]
[size=3] ﻿[ for now it most options are for the [b]Hill Top Farm[/b], where I'm currently playing [b]:P[/b] ]
[size=6] ﻿Simply put, it's[/size][size=5]  [/size][img]https://imgur.com/uwpunAG.png[/img]
﻿Look at the [i] [/i][b][s]GIF's[/s]  [/b][b]JEE[/b][b]F[/b][i]'s[/i]  in image Gallery for info about the changes.[/size]


[size=1] [size=4][img]https://imgur.com/BonY5YO.png[/img][/size][/size]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][size=4]﻿Added a [b]Bridge[/b] and [b]Fishing Pier[/b], to the [b]big lake[/b] on the bottom of the farm, allows for quick transit OR a nice fishing spot.[/size]
[*][size=4]Adds small Pier, to the little pond on the right of the players house, just 'cuz it's bloody adorable.[/size]
[/list][/spoiler]

[img]https://imgur.com/yMSLGKt.png[/img]
[spoiler]
[size=4]Adds [b]Pond[/b] replace options for [b]3[/b] out of the 4 [b]Ponds[/b] in the farm, can be replaced with [b]Tillable/Farmable Dirt[/b][/size]
[size=4]Adds [b]Grass[/b] replace option for the grass around the bigger pond [/size][size=2]( on the bottom right[b] [/b])[/size][size=4] replaced with more[b] D.I.R.T.[/b][/size]

more options to come ...
[/spoiler]

[img]https://imgur.com/YMUU7ky.png[/img]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][size=4]﻿Adds [b]Bridge to Grandpa's Shrine [/b]option, in the main cliff, to allow for a quick visit.[/size]
[*][size=4]﻿Adds [b]extra [/b]tile [b]space[/b], where you can snuggly move the [b]Greenhouse [/b]to or any building 8 tiles width.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]Added [b]Lake replace[/b] options  - can replace small lake with : [/size]
[/list][size=4] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿- Tillable/Farmable Dirt
﻿ ﻿ ﻿- [/size][size=4]Custom Grass [/size][b][size=2]( for your average grass enjoyer )[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]Added [b]Grass replace[/b] options [/size][size=2]( next to the [b]exit [/b]to the [b]forest [/b]AND [b]bellow [/b]the [b]Shrine [/b])[/size][size=4] - can replace Grass with - Tillable/Farmable Dirt[/size]
[/list]
[b]Remember [/b]- values are set to vanilla [b]Default, [/b]these changes will [b]NOT [/b]appear unless changed in the [b]Mod Configuration Menu.[/b]
[/spoiler]

[size=4][img]https://imgur.com/s0hm8dd.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]﻿Added option to Remove [b]Blocked Buildable areas[/b], in front of the [b]spouse recreation spot[/b] and in front of the [b]cave entrance [/b]( allowing players to build/move farm structures ).[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]Many options, with many more to come, easily configured :[/size]
[center][img]https://imgur.com/qczwLtx.gif[/img]﻿﻿[/center]

[size=4]Easily [b]compatible [/b]with other Farm Map mods, even expanded vanilla farm maps.[/size]


[size=5]If your NOT using [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/site/mods/1]Vortex[/url][/b], remember to click [b]Track[/b] to stay tuned when updates come out.[/size]
[size=5]And for The Emperor's sake click dat [b]Endorse [/b]Button.[/size]
[img]https://imgur.com/WmqJGXM.gif[/img][img]https://imgur.com/Ztfe5Pc.gif[/img]

[size=5]Share any additions/ideas you would like to see in [b]Your Farm[/b].[/size]
